# gnome-layout-switch

Lightweight daemon that switches GNOME keyboard layout on Ctrl+Shift. Works on X11 and Wayland (GNOME 3-48+).

## Project Type

Go CLI application (single binary, static build)

## Repository

https://github.com/sankam-nikolya/gnome-layout-switch

## Key Files

- `gnome-layout-switch.go` — Main source code (single file, ~690 lines)
- `build.sh` — Docker-based build script
- `Dockerfile` — Multi-stage build (golang:1.27-alpine)
- `Makefile` — Build, lint, format, CI targets
- `.golangci.yml` — 68 linters enabled
- `README.md` — User documentation
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — Contributor guide
- `CHANGELOG.md` — Version history (Keep a Changelog format)
- `LICENSE` — MIT License
- `config.example.json` — Example configuration

## Architecture

- **Single Go file** with no external dependencies (standard library only)
- **Two runtime modes**: X11 (xinput) and Wayland (/dev/input/eventX)
- **Three layout-switching backends** (tried in order):
  2. EvalGjs extension
  3. Classic GNOME Shell Eval (GNOME ≤40)
- **Config file**: ~/.config/gnome-layout-switch/config.json
- **Systemd user service** for auto-start on graphical login

## Key Types

- `Config` — JSON config: Key1, Key2 (comma-separated keycodes), Input (device path), Debug, Device (name filter)
- `EventData` — Parsed xinput event (Type, Detail)
- `InputEvent` — Raw Linux input event (Sec, Usec, Type, Code, Value)

## Key Functions

- `main()` — Entry point, flag parsing, config loading, mode selection
- `switchLayout()` — Tries backends in order to switch layout
- `directEvent()` — Wayland: reads from /dev/input/eventX
- `xinputMode()` — X11: uses xinput test-xi2
- `findKeyboardEvent()` — Auto-detects keyboard device from /proc/bus/input/devices
- `installService()` — Generates systemd user service unit

## Build & Install

```bash
# Docker build (no Go needed)
bash build.sh           # produces ./gnome-layout-switch
bash build.sh --install # build + install to ~/.local/bin

# Local build (requires Go)
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o gnome-layout-switch gnome-layout-switch.go

# Install systemd service
./gnome-layout-switch -install-service
systemctl --user enable --now gnome-layout-switch.service
```

## Usage

```bash
# X11
./gnome-layout-switch

# Wayland (auto-detect)
./gnome-layout-switch -auto-input

# Wayland (explicit device)
./gnome-layout-switch -input /dev/input/event3
```

## Development

```bash
make fmt       # Format with gofumpt
make lint      # Run all 68 linters
make lint-fix  # Auto-fix issues
make ci        # Lint + build (CI pipeline)
```

## Requirements

- Linux with GNOME
- gdbus (for Wayland backends)
- xinput (for X11 mode)
- On Wayland: user in 'input' group (`sudo usermod -aG input $USER`)
